flyer.justification: The flyer captures the main themes accurately, though the title exceeds the requested maximum of six words.

summary.justification: The summary adheres strictly to all format constraints, maintaining a concise, well-structured executive tone under 400 words.

instagram.justification: The post has strong visual appeal and valid hashtag counts, but lacks explicit carousel/slide cues.

linkedin.justification: Follows all LinkedIn guidelines, avoids banned clichés/buzzwords, and includes an engaging closing discussion question.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter is conversational, features three clearly structured sections with bold headers, and includes clear calls to action.

blog.justification: A comprehensive blog article that meets all formatting criteria including numbered sections, comparison table, and author bio.
